theorems.name: Submission.dpf_jm_aestronglyMeasurable_sqrt_det_compression
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (p L : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → AEStronglyMeasurable L μ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => Real.sqrt ((p x ∘L ((L x).adjoint ∘L L x) ∘L p x + (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - p x)).det)) μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
